1-800-GOT-JUNK Pricing for Appliances: What to Expect

Are you looking to get rid of old appliances but unsure about the cost? 1-800-GOT-JUNK? is a popular junk removal service that offers affordable pricing for appliance removal. In this article, we'll break down what you can expect to pay for 1-800-GOT-JUNK's appliance removal services.

Factors Affecting 1-800-GOT-JUNK Pricing

The cost of 1-800-GOT-JUNK's appliance removal services can vary depending on several factors, including:

  • Location: Prices may differ depending on the location, with urban areas typically being more expensive than rural areas.
  • Appliance size: Larger appliances, such as refrigerators and washing machines, will cost more to remove than smaller ones, like toasters and microwaves.
  • Weight: Heavier appliances will also increase the cost of removal.
  • Accessibility: Appliances located in hard-to-reach areas, such as upstairs or in cramped spaces, may incur additional fees.

1-800-GOT-JUNK Pricing Structure

1-800-GOT-JUNK's pricing structure is based on a per-item fee, which varies depending on the type and size of the appliance. Here's a general breakdown of what you can expect to pay:

  • Small appliances: $20-$40 per item (e.g., toasters, microwaves, blenders)
  • Medium appliances: $40-$60 per item (e.g., dishwashers, washing machines)
  • Large appliances: $60-$100 per item (e.g., refrigerators, stoves)

Additional Fees and Charges

In addition to the per-item fee, you may also be charged for:

  • Disposal fees: These fees are typically $10-$20 per item and are used to cover the cost of disposing of hazardous materials.
  • Fuel surcharges: These fees are used to offset the cost of fuel and may vary depending on the location.
